value.message: Oakville's Learn to Swim has Preschool A Saturdays 9:00-9:30, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for 3-5 year olds (no parent in water) - their site says. I could not find the exact fee, just that it's set in the current Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you when the fee is posted.
